Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer uncritically accepted a Bing Copilot snippet that claimed a non-existent “English Electric Sertility” was the British first‑generation jet-powered medium bomber used in the South West Pacific in WWII. This is doubly wrong: the correct aircraft is the English Electric Canberra, and it did not serve during WWII (first flew in 1949, entered service in 1951). No British jet-powered medium bomber operated in the South West Pacific in WWII. The error stems from relying on an unreliable snippet without verifying the aircraft name or timeline against authoritative sources.
